title: Christ on the Cross [reverse]
alt: A thin, haggard, nearly nude man is nailed to a wooden cross, his head drooping and eyes closed, blood trickling from his hands, side and feet, against a background streaked with tawny brown, burnt orange and gold.

title: The Crucifixion
alt: Jesus hangs on a cross against a gold background, with mourners on either side and a woman in red embracing the foot of the cross, while three angels catch the blood from his hands and side in shallow gold cups.

title: The Crucifixion
alt: In a round painting with a gold background, Jesus hangs from a cross marked INRI, with an older woman in a purple cloak standing to the left and a young man in a red cloak to the right, on a grey stone platform above a dark opening with bones.

title: The Crucifixion
alt: Against a gold background, Jesus hangs from a cross with a panel reading INRI, while small angels catch his blood in gold bowls; a woman kneels at his feet, women support a swooning woman on the left, and armoured men stand on the right.

title: The Crucifixion
alt: A crowd of more than two dozen people, many armed with spears and some on horseback, presses around three men hanging on crosses; a rider on a white horse pierces the central man's side, and a fainting woman is supported at the lower left.
